author: F2F official
description: A sun-baked desert old town. A, Dyers' Court: down the long Spice Road through the Spice Doors to the Spice Arch, or up the Balcony Steps off mid. B, Cistern Yard: through the covered Souk to the Souk Arch, or along Lantern Row to the Lantern Door. Mid: Caravan Street up to the Mid Doors.
name: Saffra
